_source: Hand-written from unifi-cli's tracked source (lib/api/map/map.mjs endpoint rows and the task/request shapes) and the UniFi documentation — documentation addresses (RFC 5737) and MACs (RFC 7042) only; ids are patterned. unifi-cli's device_list row (api/s/{site}/stat/device). The rows carry the stat fields too (cpu, mem, uptime, last_uplink) — stat/device answers one row per device carrying both the inventory and the stat read.
